items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 122:1
items.html: (To the question) What is spirit within spirit? The coupling of the kisses is called a coupling of spirit within spirit, and this is in relation to the external Partzuf of the HGT. That is to say, they are discerned as spirit within spirit, even though they are truly GAR; but because the root of the GAR of ZA comes from the force of the HGT that became KHB, therefore the coupling of the GAR is discerned by the name Ruach, after its root. (Item 178).
